shared_elements: arms/appendages extended horizontally to both sides
legs shown apart below the body
justification: Both depict a single frontal, bilaterally symmetrical anthropomorph with limbs (or wings) spread horizontally and legs apart, centred alone on the field, which is a real but very common compositional correspondence. They differ sharply in specificity and manner: B is a densely detailed bird-man with a beaked head, feathered wings, headdress, belts, necklace and skirt, while A is a bare, schematic stick-like outline figure with no attributes, wings or facial features.
